products.name: KIAC
products.description: Local Kubernetes on Apple's container framework, every node is its own lightweight VM. Metrics, storage, and LoadBalancer included out of the box.
products.longDescription: KIAC runs real multi-node Kubernetes clusters on macOS using Apple's native container framework. Unlike Docker-based local clusters, every node is its own lightweight VM with a real kernel, so eBPF, Cilium, and kernel-level features actually work. Ships with metrics-server, local-path storage, and a LoadBalancer implementation, so the cluster feels like a cloud cluster from the first command.
features: Every node is a lightweight VM with a real kernel, eBPF and Cilium work
Multi-node clusters on Apple Silicon in seconds
metrics-server, storage, and LoadBalancer included
Full-kernel mode for advanced CNI experiments
useCases: Testing operators and CNIs on Apple Silicon

products.name: SRELens
products.description: A Kubernetes desktop workspace built in Rust, fast, native, and ready for both engineers and AI agents.
products.longDescription: SRELens is a desktop control room for Kubernetes built in Rust with Tauri. Browse and act on workloads across contexts, install and diff Helm releases with a values editor and rendered-diff preview, manage kubectl/krew/helm from a built-in toolbox, watch node and pod metrics, and take operational actions, scale, restart rollouts, evict pods. Designed from day one to be driven by AI agents as well as humans (MCP support).
features: Native Rust performance, no Electron
Helm releases with values editor and rendered-diff preview
Built-in toolbox: kubectl, krew, helm, plugin management
MCP-ready: AI agents can drive the same operations
Scale, restart, evict, delete, operational actions built in

products.name: kubectl upgrade
products.tagline: The conductor for any Kubernetes upgrade
products.description: Pre-flight, run, watch, unstick, verify, one kubectl plugin that conducts cluster upgrades end to end, including fleets.
products.longDescription: Upgrading Kubernetes is the scariest routine operation in the job. kubectl upgrade turns it into a conducted process: pre-flight checks catch version-skew and addon incompatibilities before you start, the run phase executes the upgrade, watch mode streams progress, unstick helps when nodes wedge, and verify confirms the cluster is healthy after. Works across single clusters and fleets. Installs as a standard kubectl plugin, no krew required.
features: Pre-flight: version skew, addon compatibility, PDB and drain checks
Conducted upgrade flow: run, watch, unstick, verify
Fleet mode for many clusters
Standard kubectl plugin, auto-discovered, no krew needed

products.name: ing-switch
products.tagline: Escape Ingress NGINX in minutes, not days
products.description: Migrate Kubernetes Ingress NGINX to Traefik or Gateway API, automated scanning, annotation mapping, and manifest generation. CLI + web UI.
products.longDescription: With Ingress NGINX retired, thousands of clusters need a migration path. ing-switch scans your cluster, analyzes every ingress annotation with compatibility impact ratings, and generates a complete migration kit: a migration report, Gateway API CRD installers, Envoy Gateway or Traefik setup, and rewritten manifests. What used to be days of annotation archaeology becomes a reviewed pull request.
products.install: curl -L https://github.com/saiyam1814/ing-switch/releases/latest/download/ing-switch-darwin-arm64 -o ing-switch && chmod +x ing-switch && sudo mv ing-switch /usr/local/bin/
features: Scans every Ingress and rates annotation compatibility
Generates full migration kit: report, CRDs, gateway, manifests
Targets Traefik or Gateway API (Envoy Gateway)
CLI for automation, web UI for review

products.name: memwarden
products.description: Verified, self-custodied memory for AI coding agents, audit what your agents remember, share one memory across all of them.
products.longDescription: AI coding agents accumulate memory, and that memory is unverified, scattered per-tool, and stored who-knows-where. memwarden gives you one self-custodied memory store shared across every agent, with verification built in: memories carry provenance, get re-verified against the code they reference, and stale or unsourced memories are firewalled at recall time instead of silently poisoning your agents. Audit the memory you already have with a single npx command.
features: One memory store shared by every coding agent
Provenance and trust states on every memory
Recall-time firewall blocks stale or unverified memories
Self-custodied: your memory lives with you, not a vendor
Zero-install audit of existing agent memory
useCases: Claude Code / AI agent memory hygiene
